source.title: Đáp án/transcript: TOEIC LR Collection 1 Test 4 - STUDY4

children.text: (C) Some cups are being stacked on the table.
(D) Some pastries are being placed in a display case.
(A) Some leaves are gathered into piles.
(B) A man is sitting on a bench.
(D) Branches are hanging over a walkway.
(A) A pedestrian is climbing some steps.
(B) Some planters have been lined along a curb.
(D) A door has been left open.
(A) Some books are stacked on a cart.
(B) Some books are spread out on a table.
(C) One of the women is standing at a shelf.
(D) One of the women is opening a box.
(A) He's slicing bread on a cutting board.
(C) He's arranging sandwiches on a tray.
Where did Bridget put the floor plans for the client meeting?
(A) She stacked them on the drafting table.
(B) So the client could review the layout.
(C) A long line at the print room.
Which song did you want me to mix first?
Has tonight's performance been postponed till tomorrow?
(A) Around two hundred tickets have sold.
(B) No, it's still starting at seven thirty.
(C) It's a comedy about two neighbors.
I liked the old floor plan much better.
(A) The new one gets much more natural light.
(B) My chair is right next to the window.
(C) Actually, I rarely come up to this floor.
Isn't Jonas going to handle the outdoor shoot this afternoon?
I don't think we'll have time to change before our dinner reservation.
(A) Yes, I've already got change from the front desk.
(B) Your room key is ready at the front desk.
(C) There's a restroom with mirrors just past the elevators.
The rooftop solar panels are almost fully installed.
(A) The panel meets again on Thursday morning.
(B) You'd better check with the electrician.
(C) We won't be paying nearly as much for power.
How do I get the wash cycle to start?
(A) Yes, I washed it last weekend.
(C) The tokens are in that dispenser.
The music in here is really loud today, isn't it?
(B) They're trying out a new sound system.
We're hiring a few more line cooks for the summer.
(A) My cousin's been looking for kitchen work.
(B) The stew's been simmering since noon.
(C) They hired a new dishwasher last month.
Our copy editor is leaving for another publisher next month.
(A) We can push the deadline back.
How do I print my boarding pass at this kiosk?
(A) You'll need to scan your passport first.
(C) I printed mine at home this morning.
We've gotten a lot of applications for the summer program this year.
(A) The deadline is posted on our website.
(B) I know—scheduling the placement interviews will take weeks.
(C) Applicants can pay the fee online.
We should reorganize the children's section this week.
(A) No, put them on the bottom shelf.
(B) The picture books just came in.
(C) I was actually going to suggest the same thing.
When is tomorrow's town-hall meeting supposed to start?
(A) The deputy mayor will be leading it.
(C) It's actually been rescheduled for next week.
Who's in charge of booking the guest interviews?
(A) Ms. Ferreira takes care of that.
(B) Usually right before the morning show.
When will the swimming pool reopen?
(A) They're still replacing the tile around the edge.
(B) Would you like a schedule of our fitness classes?
(C) The main doors open at six each morning.
How did you like yesterday's yoga class?
Where do we leave the outgoing packages for pickup?
(A) The courier picks up at four.
(B) On the shelf by the loading door.
The self-checkout machine is jammed again.
(A) Traffic was jammed near the entrance.
(B) Just three books and a DVD.
(C) I'll go find a technician right now.
How do I get to the cardiology ward?
(B) Yes, the heart tests came back fine.
(C) The information desk can help with that.
Will you be at Saturday's park cleanup?
Could you print the agenda copies before the meeting starts?
(C) You should submit it by Friday.
How do I submit my monthly expense report?
(B) Before the fifth of each month.
(C) You'll need to email the receipts to accounting.
Why did Ramona move up the start time for today's delivery shift?
(A) Because a big client needs an early drop-off.
(B) She shifted the boxes to the back.
(C) The van wouldn't start this morning.
